module.name: aws_eks_cluster_create
module.description: Provision a new AWS EKS cluster (VPC, subnets across 3 AZs, NAT, managed node group, IRSA OIDC) ready for BNK. Uses the upstream terraform-aws-modules/vpc/aws and terraform-aws-modules/eks/aws so production hardening (IMDSv2, EBS encryption, OIDC, control-plane logging) comes from a widely-audited baseline. Outputs match aws_eks_cluster_register_existing's shape so the downstream BNK install chain is identical regardless of provisioning path.

required.name: aws_access_key_id
required.description: AWS access key ID. Resolved by Forge's credential template at deploy time — populated for all three auth methods (access_keys, profile, sso) via boto3 normalization.

required.name: aws_secret_access_key
required.description: AWS secret access key. Resolved by Forge's credential template at deploy time. Populated regardless of auth method.

required.name: aws_region
required.description: AWS region to provision the new EKS cluster in.

required.name: eks_cluster_name
required.description: Name for the new EKS cluster. Also used as a prefix for VPC, subnet, IAM role names.

optional.name: aws_session_token
optional.description: AWS session token. Populated for STS-assumed-role, AWS SSO, and any profile that derives temporary credentials. Empty for long-lived IAM user keys.

optional.name: eks_cluster_version
optional.description: EKS Kubernetes minor version (e.g. '1.30'). Empty = community module picks the latest stable.

optional.name: vpc_cidr
optional.description: CIDR block for the new VPC. Default leaves room for /24 subnets per AZ.

optional.name: worker_instance_type
optional.description: EC2 instance type for the EKS managed node group.

optional.name: worker_count_per_az
optional.description: Desired worker nodes per AZ. Total nodes = this × availability_zone_count.

optional.name: tag_private_subnets_for_tmm
optional.description: When true, tag private subnets with 'f5-bnk-role=tmm-external' so the cluster-create outputs (and downstream cneinstall) can auto-discover them for the BNKGateway CR's defaultListenerNetworks.

key_outputs.name: cluster_id
key_outputs.description: EKS cluster ARN — used by BNK Forge for cluster registration.

key_outputs.name: cluster_oidc_issuer_url
key_outputs.description: OIDC issuer URL — used downstream for IRSA configuration.

key_outputs.name: kubeconfig
key_outputs.description: Base64-encoded kubeconfig with a short-lived STS token. BNK Forge ingests this on first scan.

key_outputs.name: vpc_id
key_outputs.description: VPC ID the new EKS cluster lives in.

key_outputs.name: vpc_cidr
key_outputs.description: Primary CIDR block of the VPC.

key_outputs.name: subnet_ids
key_outputs.description: All subnet IDs (private + public) attached to the EKS cluster.

key_outputs.name: cloud_az_subnet_mappings
key_outputs.description: AZ → subnets list (private subnets). Consumed by cneinstall for the cloud-network-mapping ConfigMap.

key_outputs.name: tmm_external_subnets_by_az
key_outputs.description: AZ → TMM external subnets list (private subnets tagged f5-bnk-role=tmm-external). Empty when tag_private_subnets_for_tmm = false. cneinstall consumes this to auto-build the BNKGateway CR's defaultListenerNetworks.

key_outputs.name: worker_node_count
key_outputs.description: Total worker node count: worker_count_per_az × az_count.

key_outputs.name: availability_zone_count
key_outputs.description: Number of distinct AZs the cluster spans.

key_outputs.name: oidc_provider_arn
key_outputs.description: ARN of the IAM OIDC provider created by the EKS community module for IRSA. cneinstall derives this independently; this output is for any downstream module that wants the ARN directly.

required.name: aws_access_key_id
required.description: AWS credential template (any auth method — access_keys, profile, or sso). Forge resolves it to access_key_id at deploy time.

required.name: aws_secret_access_key
required.description: AWS credential template (any auth method). Forge resolves to secret_access_key at deploy time.

optional.name: aws_session_token
optional.description: AWS credential template (any auth method). Forge populates this for STS / SSO / profiles that derive temporary credentials; empty for static long-lived keys.
